name: rosw
description: Claude Code plugins from the ROSW repo.

plugins.name: rosw
plugins.description: The ROSW pipelines: a checkpointed creative-writing pipeline with its vault, chunk tagging and plot-logic checks, and the studio pipeline that walks one made thing through six stages and records it in the studio vault.

plugins.name: ui-design
plugins.description: Searchable UI styles, palettes, fonts, UX rules, icons, motion and stacks; a contrast-checked design-system generator; a brief router; multipart search and page-review agents.

plugins.name: blender
plugins.description: Drive a live Blender through the MCP for Blender server: scene inspection, bpy scripting checked by looking at the result, asset sourcing and 3D generation, a Poly Haven Asset Browser guide, and named tools for your own add-ons.

plugins.name: reach
plugins.description: Read access to the internet for Claude through Agent Reach: set up and health-check it, and route research across 15 platforms (web, search, YouTube, Reddit, GitHub, Bilibili, RSS and more) through each platform's own upstream tool.

plugins.name: udgt
plugins.description: UI, Dataset & Gameplay Teardown: pull a game's repository apart into a cross-linked dataset, Describe/Compare/Critique chapters written with the owner through creative briefs, and an explorer page dressed in the game's own look.
